fonts.text: Compare the approved look with a material and lighting trial. Same character. Same camera.

Coat changes remain subtle; the second trial added no clear visible gain. The animated chat mascot still uses the approved look. This viewer compares saved Blender renders; it does not demonstrate animation or app performance.
